description: Green, damp, a shoot coming up out of its head, and a little wooden sword in a fist it does not really have.
lore: The wood's ling is green and damp, with a live shoot coming up out of its head. A wood, to nearly everyone who ever remembered one, is a place you went into to take something out of, and the stroke is the part that comes back identical from every rememberer — so it carries a small pale-wood sword out of nowhere in particular and swings it at travellers and passing birds with the same blank willingness. No grudge; there is nothing in it that could hold one.

[[characters/54bead23|Osric]] burns charcoal at the wood's edge, and in his first month here — he still said weeks then, as if weeks were load-bearing — one walked its round through his camp every day and swung at him every time. What offended him was not the swinging but the grip. He stopped dodging, took the little fist it does not really have, and set the sword properly in it, the way you set an apprentice's. It struck him anyway. He maintains it struck better.

Broken, it is chips before you can regret it, small green pieces in all directions at once, and what stays behind is [[items/dark_grain_soulstone|a stone with black grain run through it like sawn timber]]. Osric buys those from the woodcutters. His own one still comes through the camp, and he has moved the woodpile out of its road, and he does not say what he will do on the morning the round comes through empty.
